fixes.what: The test copied tcb/scripts/ into every temp root and ran <root>/tcb/scripts/guard-hook.mjs (every case: Cannot find module). It now runs the live hook tcb/guard-hook.mjs with --root <temp root>. A temp root gets data files only, with no script copy and no stub scripts; the hook finds the coordinator's named scripts beside its own file (import.meta.url).

T5 Bash commands moved to the flat grammar (node tcb/status.mjs, the absolute quoted form, tcb/lib.mjs, tcb/nosuch.mjs, tcb/Status.mjs). Two cases were added: the old layout node tcb/scripts/status.mjs and its absolute form are bash-pattern. Read/Glob/Write cases naming tcb/scripts/... now name tcb/lib.mjs, tcb/ and tcb/x.mjs. The expected results are unchanged.
T11 hook-copy-under-wt copied the whole script folder. It now copies only guard-hook.mjs and lib.mjs. The expectation is still run-from-attempt.
T14 expects the flat settings hook command "{node}" "{root}/tcb/guard-hook.mjs" ... and the coordinator allow rule Bash(node tcb/*), as shipped.
runCases ran up to 8 hook processes at once. That is now 2, the brief's limit. No assertion changed.
Flat layout: the test runs the live tcb/selftest.mjs, and the stubs are written to <root>/tcb/<name>.mjs. T3's missing-script case removes tcb/snap.mjs.

The default guard-hook fixtures printed a JSON line, so the script (spec step 5: guard-hook stdout is expected empty) failed both of them. That broke T1 and T2. The good default now prints nothing, and the bad default exits 2 with a [guard-hook] deny stderr line and stderr_prefix. The step-5 test gains a case showing that a printing guard-hook stub fails by default.
The tests now follow the revised no-burst selftest spec. They use the default --jobs (1) instead of 4, watch cases carry --once --no-intake, and T6 compares --jobs 2 with --jobs 1.

T5 strengthened. A next-in-order case checks that the timed-out stub and its grandchild are dead when it starts. Both must also be dead at the end with no grace wait, all 50 cases must run, the run must take under 42 s, and the stub now sleeps 45 s.

T5b rewritten to the new watch rule: six bad variants, each giving watch-case-loops with no case run and no tmp/ case root. The old good-alarm/good-intake half contradicted the revised spec and was replaced by a bounded --once --no-intake case.
T5c strengthened: the case root's tcb/ has no .mjs and no scripts/, the data folders are present, and the stub's argv[1] is <root>/tcb/render.mjs.
New T5e: case roots alive at each case start are always 1 by default and at most 2 with --jobs 2. --jobs 3 and --jobs 0 exit 66.

New T5f: a detached grandchild holding the stub's stdout gives left-process, exit 2 case-left-process, not_run with only the two cases that ran, and 47 cases in not_started. The grandchild expires by itself after 8 s and the test waits for it.
T8 strengthened: tcb-changed is the first reason and its detail names the case, and no later case ran (markers, selftest.json, not_started).
Stub options added: --stub-count-roots, --stub-alive-check, --stub-holder, plus argv1 and mjs_files in --stub-probe. defaultFixtures takes extra stub args.
